summary: Iter 16 — narrow retest of the iter-15 auto-straighten regression in ProMappingStudio trace tool. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/pro-mapping-v2.js (isNearStraight: `points.length<2` guard + explicit 2-point shortcut at line 235-236) was validated end-to-end via Playwright. All 4 targeted assertions now PASS. No other functional regressions observed; not retesting the 18/21 iter-15 PASS items per E1 instructions.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: isNearStraight now returns false only on points.length<2, and explicitly returns true when points.length===2 (after the len>=0.02 degenerate gate). Matches the spec that an RDP-simplified 2-point list IS a straight line by definition.

Carry-forward from iter 15 (NOT retested, still valid): ProMappingStudio.jsx is ~1343 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Candidates: SelectionFrame + GridEditOverlay + DraftOverlay + MarkupOverlay → canvas-overlays module; CleanReconstructionCanvas + children → separate file; InspectorPane + AssetsPane → StudioDockPanes.jsx.
Carry-forward: handle hit-testing uses fixed handleR=0.018 in normalized space; below WCAG 24px at 1x zoom on phones. Consider scaling by 1/zoom.

Minor: inspector row text renders the kind twice ('lineline','tracetrace' captured by textContent) because the kind label plus the field/description both read as the same word. Cosmetically fine but could be confusing during accessibility reads; consider adding aria-label with a single human phrase.

rca of the issue: iter-15 bug: rdpSimplify(points, tolerance=0.002) can collapse a screen-perfect straight stroke to exactly 2 endpoint samples, and isNearStraight had `if (points.length < 3) return false`, rejecting the 2-point list and falling through to the trace-commit branch. Fix applied by main agent in /app/frontend/src/lib/pro-mapping-v2.js (line 229 `points.length < 2` and lines 235-236 `if (points.length === 2) return true;` after the len>=0.02 degenerate gate). Verified by drawing a ~flat horizontal stroke with freehand OFF and observing inspector row kind='line'; then toggling freehand ON and observing kind='trace' for the 2nd stroke. Both conditions now behave per spec.
